skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge about customs, customs operations, and tax management for imported/exported goods.
Analyze and solve practical issues related to customs and taxation.
Apply knowledge about origin of goods, valuation, intellectual property protection, and tax management to ensure effective customs operations.
Understand and apply legal knowledge related to customs and taxation.
Develop independent learning and research skills, and improve professional expertise.
Work effectively in groups and individually, and present scientific content related to customs.
Analyze factors influencing decision-making in customs operations.
Identify and solve practical issues in customs operations.
Prepare and deliver presentations on customs-related topics.
Conduct independent research and gather information to complete assignments.
